scope: Private query deadline tests retain real SQLite, provider promises, fallback/fusion and cancellation. Production settings and public contracts are unchanged.
method: Eight test commands in a dedicated checkout/dependencies, serialized shared benchmark lock. All92 original matcher expressions and32 test-name expressions retained; candidate104 matchers/33 names with a separate default-duration case. Source55 awaits become60 through controlled deadline and explicit cleanup/continuation fences. All production mutations restored byte-identically.

runtime.isolation: Original bun run test preload plus explicit ordinary-UID user/network namespace; loopback enabled, no external route; capabilities dropped before test process. No browser or build. Namespace address/route/UID-map receipts retained.
runtime.resources: GNU time inside shared benchmark lock after namespace setup; shared-host background load uncontrolled. RSS is the command process-tree maximum, not a sum. Setup spans were not separately instrumented.

clockBoundary.nativeTurns: Three source-scoped setImmediate fences in each full candidate: two pre-deadline pending checks and one late-provider continuation. Their individual elapsed spans were not measured.
clockBoundary.registration: Each case asserts the actual timeout argument registered by production. The clock invokes the original callback; early/late registration and removed cancellation faults fail. Full property descriptors restore in finally.
clockBoundary.database: The late case closes real SQLite, forwards prepare with original this/arguments, resolves the original provider, then awaits one native event-loop turn. The inspected continuation has no intervening timer/IO before synchronous prepare. This is not a global drain.
clockBoundary.logicalTotalBasis: Sum of separate case advances by source arithmetic, not wall time or separately instrumented callback count.
